messages:
maria: Heads-up — saw the cluster autoscaler do rapid scale-ups then scale-downs in eu-west after the morning load test. Pods stayed Pending for >2m. Suspect IP quota + spot churn combo.
logan: ugh, that explains the 504s on /infer. Any node events?
ash: saw a bunch of `CreateNode` timeouts and then `InstanceTerminated` events for spot VMs. Also kube-proxy kept flapping on 2 nodes.
maria: copying relevant logs: `kubectl describe nodes | grep -A5 -i 'Event'` showed quotaExceeded for externalIps on the subnet.
sre-bot: Incident detected: cluster eu-west-2 autoscaler flapping. Alert routed to #oncall.
logan: quick mitigation idea: bump fallback pool min-size (non-spot) by 1 for the next 2 hours and enable cross-region fallback to eu-central if provisioning fails for >3m.
kevin: can we do that via terraform safely? I don't want manual edits that drift.
ash: yes — change is two parts: terraform for nodepool min size & taints, and helm values for cluster-autoscaler flags. Example Helm override: ```yaml
autoscaler:
  extraArgs:
    scale-down-unneeded-time: "10m"
    scale-down-delay-after-add: "5m"
    --balance-similar-node-groups: "true"
```
logan: and on the terraform side: update the node pool module with `min_size = var.burst_min` and add `preemptible = false` for the temporary fallback pool. We can gate via a feature flag var so it's reversible.
maria: also want to add a policy: when external IP quota < 10% remaining, block scheduling of new GPU preemptible pools and route new jobs to dedicated pool. That should reduce the churn.
devops: I'll open a PR against infra: `infra/modules/nodepool/main.tf` with the flag `enable_quota_fallback = true` and the module will create a small on-demand buffer pool.
kevin: ping me when PR is up — want to run `terraform plan` with current quotas. We should also add a guard in helm chart: `--skip-nodes-with-local-storage=false`? Not sure.
logan: instead of messing with local-storage flag, set `--expander=least-waste` and `--max-node-provision-time=6m` so autoscaler gives up faster and falls back to the on-demand pool.
ash: we'll need to update our helm values file `values/autoscaler-values.yaml` and ship as part of the same release. I'll draft the changes and link the PR.
maria: ops playbook steps for oncall if this reoccurs: 1) scale up fallback pool via terraform var override; 2) temporarily cordon preemptible GPU pools; 3) increase subnet IP quota (support ticket). I'll add the playbook to runbook doc.
devops: raising support ticket now, ref #INC-9742. CC: @cloud-team.
sre-bot: autoscaler status snapshot: desired=45 current=28 safe-to-evict=12.
logan: if quota request will take >4h, we should enable cross-region fallback earlier. Who owns that?
kevin: infra owns cross-region routing. I'll prepare a small helm hook that labels pods with `fallback=eu-central` and the scheduler policy will prefer eu-central after 4m.
maria: ok assigning: devops -> PR for terraform buffer pool, ash -> helm autoscaler flags PR, kevin -> scheduler fallback hook, logan -> monitor dashboard updates and alert thresholds.
ash: PRs will reference this thread. Let's reconvene in 30m. :eyes: 
maria: thanks — appreciate the quick sync. :thumbsup:
